title: Find the right work to hand over.
intro: Explore practical overseas assistance for executives, operations and specialist office teams. Start with a familiar workflow, set the hours you need covered and choose the responsibilities your team can train and review clearly.
caption: Different responsibilities. One connected way of working.
groups: Match the role to the work
Choose a recurring responsibility with a clear output. An executive diary, online store and clinical office each need different instructions, systems and boundaries.
Agree working hours, response expectations and the time your team can answer questions. Leave an accessible handoff record when colleagues work in different time zones.
Use recent, appropriately redacted work to explain the task. Confirm access, a named reviewer and escalation rules before moving into a live queue.
